record.bible_text: And Samuel<WH08050> died<WH04191><WTH8799>; and all the Israelites<WH03478> were gathered together<WH06908><WTH8735>, and lamented<WH05594><WTH8799> him, and buried<WH06912><WTH8799> him in his house<WH01004> at Ramah<WH07414>.
